title: Orientation
description: auto: a horizontal strip when the page is at least 2.4× wider than tall (e.g. taiko's bottom row), otherwise a vertical column. Type and graphics scale to the page size.

title: Alignment
description: Which edge the readout hugs, so it can sit on either side of the screen or stage. auto: right for the column, left for the strip. In the strip, right also mirrors the order (rail first, pp last).

title: Motion
description: full = the changing digits of pp roll, the rail eases, and after a choke the If FC value detaches from pp. reduced = the rail, the If FC detach and enter/exit still ease; digits snap. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Corner marks
description: The 18-LAB registration marks on the box's top-left and bottom-right corners. neutral = warm white. amber = both in 18-LAB amber. tl = amber, top-left only. none = no marks.

title: Show If FC pp
description: Once the full combo is lost (a miss or combo break), what the score would be worth as a full combo at the current accuracy, on its own line under pp, plus a tick on the rail. At results: the If FC value and the gap to it.

title: Show max achievable pp
description: During play, the band on the rail from current pp to the most this attempt can still reach if every remaining object is hit perfectly.

title: Show pp breakdown
description: During play, current pp split into its non-zero components on the line under pp (aim, speed, accuracy and flashlight for osu!; difficulty and accuracy for taiko, catch and mania), until the If FC value takes that line.

title: Show accuracy ladder in song select
description: pp at 95, 97, 98, 99 and 100% accuracy for the selected map and mods — osu! does not show pp in song select. Off: nothing is shown in song select.

title: Decimal places
description: Decimal places on the live pp readout. The If FC value, ladder, breakdown and rail scale always show whole pp.
